`class RoundedNodeEffect`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEffect<Node>`](/reference/effects/nodeeffect/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.effect.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [RoundedNodeEffect.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/effect/impl/RoundedNodeEffect.java)

Rounds the corners of what a node draws, all four or only some of them.

![A grey rectangle with rounded corners](/captures/catalog-effects-roundednodeeffect.webp)

## Description

The corners are cut from the pixels of the node, so it rounds a rectangle, an image or a video alike.
The radius never goes past half the shorter side: `create(999F)` turns a rectangle into a pill.
A [`BorderNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/bordernodeeffect/) on the same node outlines the rounded shape, and a [`ShadowNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/shadownodeeffect/) takes its radius and its sides.
Its priority is `100`, so its pass runs before a blur and a border.
